actions.action: Choose one cool, bright spot away from heaters and leave the plant there
Place on balcony in bright shade or morning sun rather than full sun
Bring plant indoors if nights drop below about 0–2 °C
Pinch or cut off dead flowers at the base of their stalks
Check top 1–2 cm of soil and water at soil level when dry
Make sure the pot drains and doesn't sit in water
Feed with dilute flowering-plant fertilizer every 2 weeks
Plant outside in a shaded garden spot or larger pot once weather is mild
Watch for mushy tissue, gray fuzz or collapsing leaves and post again if seen

reason: The answer says plainly that the plant is healthy and that the spent flowers are normal aging. Its main advice of pinching off dead flowers and moving the plant outside to shade or morning sun matches the advice that worked. Its extra care tips, such as stopping misting and keeping it cool, are mild and not harmful.
